entries.task: Wake and verify the live Academy Supabase database before any production schema change
entries.why_owner_authority_is_required: Connected project metadata is available, but the live database/security advisor currently reports the Academy project as hibernated. Waking or altering live compute is intentionally not performed without explicit production authorization.
entries.what_credential_or_action_is_missing: Explicit approval to wake the live Academy Supabase project and perform read-only production schema/RLS verification first.
entries.exact_owner_action: Explicitly authorize the Academy Supabase project to be woken for production verification, or wake Nexal Academy MVP in Supabase and confirm it is ready for inspection.
entries.what_local_work_is_already_complete: The configured project ref is verified, public client metadata is reachable, local auth guards are tested, avatar storage is private-by-default, LMS/announcement migrations are hardened, and local/browser quality gates pass.

entries.task: Enable and acceptance-test Google OAuth for Academy
entries.why_owner_authority_is_required: Google OAuth provider secrets and production redirect configuration are external account settings and must not be committed to the repository.
entries.what_credential_or_action_is_missing: Google Web OAuth client configuration plus permission to change the Academy Supabase Auth provider settings.
entries.exact_owner_action: Follow GOOGLE_AUTH_OWNER_SETUP.md, enable Google for the Academy Supabase project, configure the production callback/origin, then authorize a real login smoke test.
entries.what_local_work_is_already_complete: Google login UI, safe redirect restoration, auth-callback.html, loading/error handling, and session handoff logic are implemented.

entries.task: Deploy and verify protected Premium content storage/RLS
entries.why_owner_authority_is_required: Premium lesson bodies cannot be securely monetized while full content remains in public static assets. Applying production schema/RLS is a live data-plane change.
entries.what_credential_or_action_is_missing: An awake/verified Academy database and explicit permission to apply the protected-content migration plan.
entries.exact_owner_action: After the live database audit is clean, authorize deployment of the protected catalogue/preview/lesson-body model described in PREMIUM_CONTENT_SECURITY.md and run Free-versus-Premium direct-access denial tests.
entries.what_local_work_is_already_complete: Access metadata, free-showcase rules, entitlement fixtures, pricing UX, curriculum coverage, and local security contracts are prepared.

entries.task: Activate a real Premium payment provider
entries.why_owner_authority_is_required: A merchant account, commercial terms, plan identifiers and production webhook secrets require owner/business authorization.
entries.what_credential_or_action_is_missing: Approved payment provider account, live plan/price identifiers, webhook endpoint and secrets.
entries.exact_owner_action: Choose and authorize the Academy payment provider, then allow checkout/webhook entitlement wiring and a paid-to-entitlement smoke test.
entries.what_local_work_is_already_complete: Free/Premium comparison, provider-independent upgrade boundary, honest pre-launch pricing state, and entitlement fixtures are implemented.

entries.task: Confirm and verify the Academy production hosting target
entries.why_owner_authority_is_required: Browser QA now passes without deployment, but publishing or repointing a production host is a live release action. No Academy project is present in the currently connected Vercel account.
entries.what_credential_or_action_is_missing: The intended production hosting target and explicit release authorization.
entries.exact_owner_action: Confirm the authorized Academy production host when ready for release; do not repurpose another Nexal deployment.
entries.what_local_work_is_already_complete: CI serves the Academy locally and captures passing desktop/mobile browser evidence without requiring a production deployment.
